doc: Hosts the desk fetched or captured from with no reviewed-terms record, ranked by observations (desc), then number of inputs (desc), then host. A later session reads each host's terms and adds its record to libs/data/terms_records.json (URL, date, verbatim clause). NOT a permission.
ranking: observations desc, n_inputs desc, host asc
coverage_gap: collectors that keep no per-host fetch record on disk (alt_proxies, keyed_sources, free_stack, index_discovery, live feeds: polite_fetch STATS are per leg and in memory) are not in these counts; their volume is UNMEASURED, not zero
